t: This chrome single lever mono mixer kitchen tap provides precise water flow and temperature control. Suitable for high and low pressure systems, it is an ideal choice for new installations and renovation projects. Features a 35mm ceramic cartridge ensuring reliable performance, with single lever operation for easy adjustment, and deck-mounted design with swivel spout offering flexibility in use. Supplied with flexible braided hoses and built-in pre-filters.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
